    12	/-!
    13	# The separably closed Picard representer as Jacobian data
    14	
    15	The admissible Abel chart is etale-locally surjective onto the exact representing
    16	scheme obtained from the separably closed Picard construction.  Its quasi-compact
    17	divisor source therefore supplies quasi-compactness of that exact carrier, which
    18	packages into `PicRepDatum` and then `JacobianData` without changing the carrier or
    19	its representation.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    24	
    25	universe u
    26	
    27	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    32	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    33	
    34	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    35	
    36	noncomputable section
    37	
    38	/-- Etale-local surjectivity of a Yoneda map is surjectivity on the underlying points. -/
    39	theorem surjective_of_isLocallySurjective_yoneda_map {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    40	    (h : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology (yoneda.map f)) :
    41	    Function.Surjective f.base := by
    42	  intro y
    43	  let s : ToType ((yoneda.obj Y).obj (op (Spec (Y.residueField y)))) :=
    44	    Y.fromSpecResidueField y
    45	  have hmem := h.imageSieve_mem s
    46	  obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ :=
    47	    (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mp hmem
    48	  obtain ⟨r⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum (Y.residueField y)))
    49	  obtain ⟨i, z, hz⟩ := cover.exists_eq r
    50	  have hi : (Presieve.ofArrows cover.X cover.f) (cover.f i) := ⟨i⟩
    51	  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hcover (cover.X i) (cover.f i) hi
    52	  change q ≫ f = cover.f i ≫ Y.fromSpecResidueField y at hq
    53	  refine ⟨q.base z, ?_⟩
    54	  have hqz := congrArg (fun g : cover.X i ⟶ Y => g.base z) hq
    55	  change f.base (q.base z) = (Y.fromSpecResidueField y).base ((cover.f i).base z) at hqz
    56	  rw [hz, Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply] at hqz
    57	  exact hqz
    58	
    59	/-- The admissible Abel chart, viewed as a scheme morphism to the exact separably closed
    60	Picard representing scheme. -/
    61	noncomputable def abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    62	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    63	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
    64	    (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C).left ⟶ (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left :=
    65	  yoneda.preimage (abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C ≫
    66	    (representableBySigmaIso (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2).inv)
    67	
    68	/-- The Yoneda map of the represented Abel morphism is the admissible Abel chart after
    69	identifying the exact representing carrier with its sigma extension. -/
    70	theorem yoneda_map_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    71	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    72	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
    73	    yoneda.map (abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C) =
    74	      abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C ≫
    75	        (representableBySigmaIso (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2).inv :=
    76	  yoneda.map_preimage _
    77	
    78	/-- The Abel morphism to the exact separably closed Picard representer is etale-locally
    79	surjective. -/
    80	theorem isLocallySurjective_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    81	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    82	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
    83	    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology
    84	      (yoneda.map (abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C)) := by
    85	  rw [yoneda_map_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter]
    86	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology
    87	      (abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C) :=
    88	    isLocallySurjective_abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C
    89	  infer_instance
    90	
    91	/-- The admissible Abel morphism is surjective on the underlying points of the exact
    92	separably closed Picard representative. -/
    93	theorem surjective_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    94	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    95	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
    96	    Function.Surjective (abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C).base :=
    97	  surjective_of_isLocallySurjective_yoneda_map _
    98	    (isLocallySurjective_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C)
    99	
   100	/-- The exact separably closed Picard representing scheme is quasi-compact over its field. -/
   101	theorem quasiCompact_pic0SepClosedRepresenter (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   102	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   103	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
   104	    QuasiCompact (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.hom := by
   105	  haveI : CompactSpace (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C).left :=
   106	    HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine.mp (quasiCompact_divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C)
   107	  exact quasiCompact_of_surjective (abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C)
   108	    (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.hom
   109	    (surjective_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C)
   110	
   111	/-- The separably closed representability theorem, recorded in the finite-level Picard datum
   112	shape at the same field. -/
   113	noncomputable def picRepDatumSepClosed (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   114	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   115	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] : PicRepDatum k k C where
   116	  J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
   117	  rep := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2
   118	  lft := locallyOfFiniteType_pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)
   119	
   120	/-- The exact separably closed Picard representative packages as Jacobian data. -/
   121	noncomputable def jacobianDataSepClosed (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   122	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   123	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] : JacobianData C :=
   124	  (picRepDatumSepClosed C).toJacobianData (quasiCompact_pic0SepClosedRepresenter C)
   125	
   126	@[simp]
   127	theorem picRepDatumSepClosed_J (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   128	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   129	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
   130	    (picRepDatumSepClosed C).J = (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 :=
   131	  rfl
   132	
   133	@[simp]
   134	theorem picRepDatumSepClosed_rep (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   135	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   136	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
   137	    (picRepDatumSepClosed C).rep = (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2 :=
   138	  rfl
   139	
   140	@[simp]
   141	theorem jacobianDataSepClosed_J (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   142	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   143	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
   144	    (jacobianDataSepClosed C).J = (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 :=
   145	  rfl
   146	
   147	@[simp]
   148	theorem jacobianDataSepClosed_rep (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   149	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   150	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
   151	    (jacobianDataSepClosed C).rep = (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2 :=
   152	  rfl
   153	
   154	end

    11	/-!
    12	# Presented étale covers of an affine base
    13	
    14	A (singleton, affine) *étale cover* of `Spec A` is a faithfully flat étale `A`-algebra `B`.
    15	For the étale-sheafification (plus) construction of the relative Picard functor, the covers
    16	of a fixed base must form a *small* directed index: this file realizes them as **presented**
    17	covers — a number of variables `n` together with an ideal of `MvPolynomial (Fin n) A` whose
    18	quotient is étale over `A` with `Spec` mapping onto `Spec A`.  The type of presented covers
    19	of `A` lives in the same universe as `A`, while still capturing every étale cover up to
    20	isomorphism of the carrier (`Algebra.EtaleCover.of` and its accessor `ofEquiv`).
    21	
    22	Surjectivity of the spectrum map is recorded instead of faithful flatness because it is
    23	statable without flatness hypotheses; combined with flatness of étale algebras it *is*
    24	faithful flatness (`Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_comap_surjective`), and that instance is
    25	provided on the carrier.
    26	
    27	## Main declarations
    28	
    29	* `Algebra.EtaleCover A`: presented étale covers of `Spec A`, a `Type u` for `A : Type u`;
    30	  `E.Carrier` is the covering algebra, with `Algebra.Etale A E.Carrier` and
    31	  `Module.FaithfullyFlat A E.Carrier` instances.
    32	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.of B hB`: any étale `A`-algebra `B` (with surjective spectrum map)
    33	  underlies a presented cover, with carrier identification `Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv`.
    34	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.Refines`: `E'` refines `E` when the covering spectrum of `E'` maps
    35	  to that of `E` over the base — a mere existence (`Prop`); the plus construction proves
    36	  independence of the chosen refinement map, so no choice of map is carried here.
    37	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.prod`: the common refinement `Spec (B ⊗[A] B')` of two covers, with
    38	  refinement witnesses `prodInl`/`prodInr` — directedness of the index
    39	  (`exists_refines_prod`).
    40	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.self`: the trivial cover `Spec A` itself, refined by every cover
    41	  (`refines_self`) — the base point of the index.
    42	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.baseChange`: the pulled-back cover along `A → A'`, with carrier
    43	  `A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier` (`baseChangeEquiv`) and the canonical `A`-algebra map
    44	  `baseChangeInclude` into it.
    45	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`: over a field `K`, every cover
    46	  is refined by a finite separable field extension of `K` (single-factor refinement) —
    47	  field-extension covers are cofinal, the form the degree theory and Galois descent
    48	  consume; `Algebra.EtaleCover.ofField` packages such an extension as a cover.
    49	-/

    59	/-- A presented étale cover of `Spec A`: a finite-variable polynomial presentation of an

    62	these covers a legitimate colimit; the carrier-level content is recovered by
    63	`Algebra.EtaleCover.of`/`ofEquiv`. -/

    65	  /-- The number of variables of the presentation. -/

    67	  /-- The ideal of relations of the presentation. -/
    68	  ideal : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)
    69	  /-- The presented algebra is étale over the base. -/
    70	  etale : Algebra.Etale A (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ ideal)
    71	  /-- The spectrum of the presented algebra covers the spectrum of the base. -/

   123	    (hB : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B))) : EtaleCover A :=

   126	    (Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial''.mp inferInstance).choose_spec.choose_spec

   130	    (hB : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B))) :

     8	/-!
     9	# Functoriality of the étale plus construction in the test algebra
    10	
    11	The étale-plus Picard group `PicEtAff C A` is functorial in the affine test: a base
    12	extension `A → A'` restricts a plus class by base-changing its representing cover
    13	(`Algebra.EtaleCover.baseChange`) and transporting the descent datum along the canonical
    14	inclusion of the carrier into its base change.  Following the mathlib idiom for maps along
    15	base extensions, the extension is carried as instances `[Algebra A A'] [IsScalarTower k A A']`
    16	rather than as an explicit `k`-algebra map.
    17	
    18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.descentBaseChange C A' E`: transport of descent classes along the base
    19	  change of the cover — well-posed because the two coprojections of the base-changed double
    20	  cover restrict to `A`-algebra maps out of the original carrier, so the keystone
    21	  `relPicAlgMap_congr` applies.
    22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.map C A'`: the induced restriction homomorphism
    23	  `PicEtAff C A →* PicEtAff C A'`.
    24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.map_unit`: naturality of the unit of the plus construction.
    25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.map_id`, `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.map_map`: the functor
    26	  laws — both are instances of `relPicAlgMap_congr`, which erases the difference between
    27	  any two transports out of the same descent class.
    28	
    29	Together with the unit (`PicEtAff.unit`), this is the presheaf structure of the one-step
    30	étale plus of the relative Picard functor on affine tests; the comparison theorems
    31	(separatedness, rigidification under a section) consume this interface.
    32	-/

     9	/-!
    10	# The relative Picard functor on affine test algebras
    11	
    12	The étale sheafification of the relative Picard functor is computed over *affine* test
    13	objects, where a test object is `Spec` of a `k`-algebra `A` (the landed
    14	`AlgebraicGeometry.overSpec k A : Over (Spec k)`) and a test map is `Spec` of a `k`-algebra
    15	map.  This file provides the algebra-indexed face of the relative Picard functor:
    16	
    17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.overSpecMap f`: `Spec` of a `k`-algebra map `f : A →ₐ[k] B`, as a
    18	  morphism `overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k A` of `Over (Spec k)`, strictly functorial
    19	  (`overSpecMap_id`, `overSpecMap_comp`).
    20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPicAlgMap C f`: restriction of relative Picard classes along
    21	  `Spec f`, a group homomorphism `relPic C (overSpec k A) →* relPic C (overSpec k B)`,
    22	  covariantly functorial in the algebra (`relPicAlgMap_id`, `relPicAlgMap_comp`).
    23	
    24	The étale plus construction (`Picard/PicEtAff.lean`) consumes only this interface: descent
    25	classes on an étale cover are an equalizer of two `relPicAlgMap`s, and all refinement
    26	transports are `relPicAlgMap`s of `A`-algebra maps restricted to `k`.

   165	      = CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left (CechPic.map (snd C T).left N)
   166	  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left,
   167	    whiskerRight_snd]
   168	
   169	/-- Restriction of relative Picard classes along a morphism of curves `g : C' ⟶ C`,
   170	at a fixed test object: pull back along `g ▷ T` and descend to the quotients. -/
   171	noncomputable def relPicMapCurveApp (g : C' ⟶ C) (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
   172	    relPic C T →* relPic C' T :=
   173	  QuotientGroup.map (picFromBase C T) (picFromBase C' T)
   174	    (CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left) (picFromBase_le_comap_whiskerRight g T)
   175	
   176	@[simp]
   177	lemma relPicMapCurveApp_mk (g : C' ⟶ C) (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   178	    (L : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic) :
   179	    relPicMapCurveApp g T (relPicMk C T L)
   180	      = relPicMk C' T (CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left L) :=
   181	  QuotientGroup.map_mk' _ _ _ _ L
   182	
   183	/-- Naturality of the relative Picard functor in the curve: a morphism of curves
   184	`g : C' ⟶ C` induces a natural transformation `Pic_{C/k} ⟶ Pic_{C'/k}`. -/
   185	noncomputable def relPicMapCurve (g : C' ⟶ C) :
   186	    relPicFunctor C ⟶ relPicFunctor C' where
   187	  app T := CommGrpCat.ofHom (relPicMapCurveApp g T.unop)
   188	  naturality T T' t := by
   189	    ext x
   190	    induction x using relPic.ind with
   191	    | mk L =>
   192	      show relPicMapCurveApp g T'.unop (relPicMap C t.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L))
   193	          = relPicMap C' t.unop (relPicMapCurveApp g T.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L))
   194	      rw [relPicMap_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMap_mk]
   195	      refine congrArg (relPicMk C' T'.unop) ?_
   196	      rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
   197	        ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left, ← Over.comp_left, whisker_exchange]
   198	
   199	@[simp]
   200	lemma relPicMapCurve_app_mk (g : C' ⟶ C) (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ)
   201	    (L : (C ⊗ T.unop).left.CechPic) :
   202	    (relPicMapCurve g).app T (relPicMk C T.unop L)
   203	      = relPicMk C' T.unop (CechPic.map (g ▷ T.unop).left L) :=
   204	  relPicMapCurveApp_mk g T.unop L
   205	
   206	/-- The curve-direction maps are strictly functorial: the identity morphism induces the
   207	identity transformation. -/
   208	lemma relPicMapCurve_id : relPicMapCurve (𝟙 C) = 𝟙 (relPicFunctor C) := by
   209	  ext T x
   210	  induction x using relPic.ind with
   211	  | mk L =>
   212	    show relPicMapCurveApp (𝟙 C) T.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L) = relPicMk C T.unop L
   213	    rw [relPicMapCurveApp_mk, MonoidalCategory.id_whiskerRight, Over.id_left,
   214	      Scheme.CechPic.map_id]
   215	    rfl
   216	
   217	/-- The curve-direction maps are strictly functorial: composition of curve morphisms
   218	goes to composition of the induced transformations (contravariantly). -/
   219	lemma relPicMapCurve_comp (g' : C'' ⟶ C') (g : C' ⟶ C) :
   220	    relPicMapCurve (g' ≫ g) = relPicMapCurve g ≫ relPicMapCurve g' := by
   221	  ext T x
   222	  induction x using relPic.ind with
   223	  | mk L =>
   224	    show relPicMapCurveApp (g' ≫ g) T.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L)
   225	        = relPicMapCurveApp g' T.unop (relPicMapCurveApp g T.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L))
   226	    rw [relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk]
   227	    refine congrArg (relPicMk C'' T.unop) ?_
   228	    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left,
   229	      ← MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight]

     8	/-!
     9	# The definitional Picard group: Čech `H¹` of the units presheaf
    10	
    11	For a scheme `X`, this file defines the Picard group of record of this development:
    12	the Čech cohomology `Ȟ¹(X, 𝒪_X^*)` on the small Zariski site, computed on **pointed
    13	covers** (one open per point of `X`, `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.UnitsCocycle`) and
    14	stabilized along the refinement preorder.
    15	
    16	## Main declarations
    17	
    18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic`: the Picard group `Ȟ¹(X, 𝒪_X^*)` as the quotient
    19	  of `Σ 𝒰, X.unitsH1 𝒰` by agreement on a common refinement, with its `CommGroup`
    20	  structure and the constructor/eliminator API `CechPic.mk`, `CechPic.ind`,
    21	  `CechPic.mk_eq_mk_iff`, `CechPic.mk_unitsRes`, `CechPic.mk_mul_mk_inf`.
    22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic.map`: contravariant functoriality — for
    23	  `f : X ⟶ Y` the pullback `Y.CechPic →* X.CechPic` — with the strict functor laws
    24	  `CechPic.map_id` and `CechPic.map_comp` (the lane keystone).
    25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic.subsingleton_of_subsingleton`: on a scheme with a
    26	  subsingleton underlying space (e.g. `Spec` of a field) the Picard group is trivial.
    27	-/
    28	
    29	set_option autoImplicit false
    30	
    31	universe u
    32	
    33	open CategoryTheory Opposite CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    36	
    37	namespace Scheme
    38	
    39	variable {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    40	
    41	/-! ## The Picard group  -/
    42	
    43	instance cechPicSetoid (X : Scheme.{u}) : Setoid (Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰) where
    44	  r p q := ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ p.1) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ q.1),
    45	    unitsRes h₁ p.2 = unitsRes h₂ q.2
    46	  iseqv := by
    47	    constructor
    48	    · exact fun p ↦ ⟨p.1, le_rfl, le_rfl, rfl⟩
    49	    · rintro p q ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
    50	      exact ⟨𝒲, h₂, h₁, e.symm⟩
    51	    · rintro p q r ⟨𝒲₁, h₁, h₂, e₁⟩ ⟨𝒲₂, h₃, h₄, e₂⟩
    52	      refine ⟨𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂, inf_le_left.trans h₁, inf_le_right.trans h₄, ?_⟩
    53	      have e₁' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₁)) e₁
    54	      have e₂' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₂)) e₂
    55	      simp only [unitsRes_unitsRes] at e₁' e₂'
    56	      exact e₁'.trans e₂'
    57	
    58	/-- The definitional Picard group of a scheme: Čech `H¹` of the units presheaf,
    59	stabilized along refinement of pointed covers. -/
    60	def CechPic (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u :=
    61	  Quotient (cechPicSetoid X)
    62	
    63	namespace CechPic
    64	
    65	/-- The Picard class of a unit Čech `H¹` class on a pointed cover. -/
    66	def mk (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : X.CechPic :=
    67	  ⟦⟨𝒰, a⟩⟧
    68	
    69	@[elab_as_elim]
    70	theorem ind {motive : X.CechPic → Prop}
    71	    (mk : ∀ (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰), motive (mk 𝒰 a)) (x : X.CechPic) :
    72	    motive x :=
    73	  Quotient.ind (fun p ↦ by obtain ⟨𝒰, a⟩ := p; exact mk 𝒰 a) x
    74	
    75	theorem mk_eq_mk_iff {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} {a : X.unitsH1 𝒰} {b : X.unitsH1 𝒱} :
    76	    mk 𝒰 a = mk 𝒱 b ↔
    77	      ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒱),
    78	        unitsRes h₁ a = unitsRes h₂ b :=
    79	  Quotient.eq
    80	
    81	/-- Two classes agreeing after restriction to a common refinement are equal; in
    82	particular `mk` is invariant under restriction. -/
    83	@[simp]
    84	theorem mk_unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
    85	    mk 𝒱 (unitsRes h a) = mk 𝒰 a :=
    86	  Quotient.sound ⟨𝒱, le_rfl, h, unitsRes_rfl _⟩
    87	
    88	private def mulSig (p q : Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
    89	    Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰 :=
    90	  ⟨p.1 ⊓ q.1, unitsRes inf_le_left p.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q.2⟩
    91	
    92	private lemma mulSig_assoc {𝒰 𝒱 𝒳 : X.PointedCover} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) (b : X.unitsH1 𝒱)
    93	    (c : X.unitsH1 𝒳) :
    94	    mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱 ⊓ 𝒳)
    95	        (unitsRes inf_le_left (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b) *
    96	          unitsRes inf_le_right c)
    97	      = mk (𝒰 ⊓ (𝒱 ⊓ 𝒳))
    98	        (unitsRes inf_le_left a *
    99	          unitsRes inf_le_right (unitsRes inf_le_left b * unitsRes inf_le_right c)) := by
   100	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱 ⊓ 𝒳, le_rfl, (inf_assoc 𝒰 𝒱 𝒳).le, ?_⟩
   101	  simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]
   102	  exact mul_assoc _ _ _
   103	
   104	private lemma mulSig_compat {p p' q q' : Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰}
   105	    (hp : p ≈ p') (hq : q ≈ q') : mulSig p q ≈ mulSig p' q' := by
   106	  obtain ⟨𝒲₁, h₁, h₂, e₁⟩ := hp
   107	  obtain ⟨𝒲₂, h₃, h₄, e₂⟩ := hq
   108	  have e₁' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₁)) e₁
   109	  have e₂' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₂)) e₂
   110	  simp only [unitsRes_unitsRes] at e₁' e₂'
   111	  refine ⟨𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂, inf_le_inf h₁ h₃, inf_le_inf h₂ h₄, ?_⟩
   112	  show unitsRes (inf_le_inf h₁ h₃) (unitsRes inf_le_left p.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q.2)
   113	      = unitsRes (inf_le_inf h₂ h₄) (unitsRes inf_le_left p'.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q'.2)
   114	  simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes]
   115	  rw [e₁', e₂']
   116	
   117	instance : CommGroup X.CechPic where
   118	  mul := Quotient.map₂ mulSig (fun _ _ hp _ _ hq ↦ mulSig_compat hp hq)
   119	  one := mk ⊤ 1
   120	  inv := Quotient.map (fun p ↦ ⟨p.1, p.2⁻¹⟩) (by
   121	    rintro p p' ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
   122	    exact ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, by simp only [map_inv, e]⟩)
   123	  mul_assoc a b c := by
   124	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
   125	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
   126	    induction c using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒳 c =>
   127	    exact mulSig_assoc a b c
   128	  one_mul a := by
   129	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
   130	    show mk (⊤ ⊓ 𝒰) (unitsRes inf_le_left (1 : X.unitsH1 ⊤) * unitsRes inf_le_right a)
   131	      = mk 𝒰 a
   132	    rw [map_one, one_mul, mk_unitsRes]
   133	  mul_one a := by
   134	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
   135	    show mk (𝒰 ⊓ ⊤) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right (1 : X.unitsH1 ⊤))
   136	      = mk 𝒰 a
   137	    rw [map_one, mul_one, mk_unitsRes]
   138	  inv_mul_cancel a := by
   139	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
   140	    show mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰) (unitsRes inf_le_left a⁻¹ * unitsRes inf_le_right a) = mk ⊤ 1
   141	    have h : unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰 ≤ 𝒰) a⁻¹
   142	        * unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰 ≤ 𝒰) a = 1 := by
   143	      rw [map_inv]
   144	      exact inv_mul_cancel _
   145	    rw [h]
   146	    exact Quotient.sound ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰, le_rfl, le_top, by rw [map_one, map_one]⟩
   147	  mul_comm a b := by
   148	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
   149	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
   150	    show mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b)
   151	      = mk (𝒱 ⊓ 𝒰) (unitsRes inf_le_left b * unitsRes inf_le_right a)
   152	    refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱, le_rfl, le_inf inf_le_right inf_le_left, ?_⟩
   153	    simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]
   154	    exact mul_comm _ _

   156	lemma one_def : (1 : X.CechPic) = mk ⊤ 1 :=
   157	  rfl

   159	/-- Multiplication of Picard classes on representatives: restrict both to the common
   160	refinement `𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱` and multiply there. Holds by definition. -/
   161	lemma mk_mul_mk_inf {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) (b : X.unitsH1 𝒱) :
   162	    mk 𝒰 a * mk 𝒱 b
   163	      = mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b) :=
   164	  rfl
   165	
   166	@[simp]
   167	lemma mk_one (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : mk 𝒰 (1 : X.unitsH1 𝒰) = 1 :=
   168	  Quotient.sound ⟨𝒰, le_rfl, le_top, by rw [map_one, map_one]⟩
   169	
   170	@[simp]
   171	lemma mk_mul_mk (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a b : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
   172	    mk 𝒰 a * mk 𝒰 b = mk 𝒰 (a * b) := by
   173	  rw [mk_mul_mk_inf]
   174	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰, le_rfl, inf_le_left, ?_⟩
   175	  simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_rfl]
   176	
   177	@[simp]
   178	lemma mk_inv (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : (mk 𝒰 a)⁻¹ = mk 𝒰 a⁻¹ :=
   179	  rfl

   181	/-! ## Functoriality: pullback of Picard classes -/
   182	
   183	private def mapSig (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : Σ 𝒰 : Y.PointedCover, Y.unitsH1 𝒰) :
   184	    Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰 :=
   185	  ⟨p.1.pullback f, f.pullbackUnitsH1 p.1 p.2⟩
   186	
   187	private lemma mapSig_compat (f : X ⟶ Y) :
   188	    ∀ {p q : Σ 𝒰 : Y.PointedCover, Y.unitsH1 𝒰}, p ≈ q → mapSig f p ≈ mapSig f q := by
   189	  rintro ⟨𝒰, a⟩ ⟨𝒱, b⟩ ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
   190	  refine ⟨𝒲.pullback f, PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₁,
   191	    PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₂, ?_⟩
   192	  show unitsRes (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₁) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a)
   193	      = unitsRes (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₂) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒱 b)
   194	  rw [Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1 f h₁ a, Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1 f h₂ b, e]
   195	
   196	/-- Contravariant functoriality of the Čech Picard group: pull the cover back pointwise,
   197	pull the unit cocycles back through `f`, restrict. -/
   198	def map (f : X ⟶ Y) : Y.CechPic →* X.CechPic where
   199	  toFun := Quotient.map (mapSig f) fun _ _ h ↦ mapSig_compat f h
   200	  map_one' := by
   201	    show mk ((⊤ : Y.PointedCover).pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 ⊤ 1) = 1
   202	    rw [map_one, mk_one]
   203	  map_mul' a b := by
   204	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
   205	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
   206	    show mk ((𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).pullback f)
   207	        (f.pullbackUnitsH1 (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b))
   208	      = mk (𝒰.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) *
   209	          mk (𝒱.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒱 b)
   210	    rw [mk_mul_mk_inf]
   211	    refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨(𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).pullback f, le_rfl,
   212	      le_inf (PointedCover.pullback_mono f inf_le_left)
   213	        (PointedCover.pullback_mono f inf_le_right), ?_⟩
   214	    simp only [map_mul, ← Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]
   215	
   216	@[simp]
   217	lemma map_mk (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) (a : Y.unitsH1 𝒰) :
   218	    map f (mk 𝒰 a) = mk (𝒰.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) :=
   219	  rfl
   220	
   221	/-- Pullback of Picard classes along the identity is the identity. -/
   222	@[simp]
   223	theorem map_id (X : Scheme.{u}) : map (𝟙 X) = MonoidHom.id X.CechPic := by
   224	  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
   225	  induction x using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
   226	  show mk (𝒰.pullback (𝟙 X)) ((𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) = mk 𝒰 a
   227	  have hle : 𝒰.pullback (𝟙 X) ≤ 𝒰 := fun x ↦ le_of_eq (by simp)
   228	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰.pullback (𝟙 X), le_rfl, hle, ?_⟩
   229	  induction a using Quot.ind with | _ γ =>
   230	  refine congrArg (Quot.mk _) ?_
   231	  ext x y T a b
   232	  rw [OneCocycle.res_ev, OneCocycle.res_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev,
   233	    γ.toOneCochain.ev_eq_evInf]
   234	  exact id_unitsAppLE _ _
   235	
   236	/-- Pullback of Picard classes along a composite (the lane keystone). -/
   237	theorem map_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) : map (f ≫ g) = (map f).comp (map g) := by
   238	  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
   239	  induction x using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
   240	  show mk (𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g)) ((f ≫ g).pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a)
   241	    = mk ((𝒰.pullback g).pullback f)
   242	        (f.pullbackUnitsH1 (𝒰.pullback g) (g.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a))
   243	  have hle : 𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g) ≤ (𝒰.pullback g).pullback f := fun x ↦ le_of_eq (by simp)
   244	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g), le_rfl, hle, ?_⟩
   245	  induction a using Quot.ind with | _ γ =>
   246	  refine congrArg (Quot.mk _) ?_
   247	  ext x y T a b
   248	  rw [OneCocycle.res_ev, OneCocycle.res_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev,
   249	    Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf, unitsAppLE_unitsAppLE]
   250	  rfl
   251	
   252	/-! ## Sanity gate: triviality over a field -/
   253	
   254	/-- On a scheme with a subsingleton underlying space — e.g. `Spec` of a field — the
   255	Čech Picard group is trivial: every pointed cover is a cover by a single open, on which
   256	every unit cocycle is a coboundary. -/

   263	  have := H1.subsingleton_of_forall_le (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat)
   264	    (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).opens (fun i j ↦ le_of_eq (congrArg _ (Subsingleton.elim i j)))

   268	theorem eq_one_of_subsingleton (X : Scheme.{u}) [Subsingleton X] (x : X.CechPic) :

/-!
# The separably closed Picard representer as Jacobian data

The admissible Abel chart is etale-locally surjective onto the exact representing
scheme obtained from the separably closed Picard construction.  Its quasi-compact
divisor source therefore supplies quasi-compactness of that exact carrier, which
packages into `PicRepDatum` and then `JacobianData` without changing the carrier or
its representation.

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

/-- Etale-local surjectivity of a Yoneda map is surjectivity on the underlying points. -/
theorem surjective_of_isLocallySurjective_yoneda_map {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (h : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology (yoneda.map f)) :
    Function.Surjective f.base := by
  intro y
  let s : ToType ((yoneda.obj Y).obj (op (Spec (Y.residueField y)))) :=
    Y.fromSpecResidueField y
  have hmem := h.imageSieve_mem s
  obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ :=
    (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mp hmem
  obtain ⟨r⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum (Y.residueField y)))
  obtain ⟨i, z, hz⟩ := cover.exists_eq r
  have hi : (Presieve.ofArrows cover.X cover.f) (cover.f i) := ⟨i⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hcover (cover.X i) (cover.f i) hi
  change q ≫ f = cover.f i ≫ Y.fromSpecResidueField y at hq
  refine ⟨q.base z, ?_⟩
  have hqz := congrArg (fun g : cover.X i ⟶ Y => g.base z) hq
  change f.base (q.base z) = (Y.fromSpecResidueField y).base ((cover.f i).base z) at hqz
  rw [hz, Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply] at hqz
  exact hqz

/-- The admissible Abel chart, viewed as a scheme morphism to the exact separably closed
Picard representing scheme. -/
noncomputable def abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
    (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C).left ⟶ (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left :=
  yoneda.preimage (abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C ≫
    (representableBySigmaIso (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2).inv)

identifying the exact representing carrier with its sigma extension. -/
theorem yoneda_map_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
    yoneda.map (abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C) =

        (representableBySigmaIso (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2).inv :=
  yoneda.map_preimage _

surjective. -/

    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology
      (yoneda.map (abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C)) := by
  rw [yoneda_map_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter]
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology
      (abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C) :=
    isLocallySurjective_abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C
  infer_instance

separably closed Picard representative. -/
theorem surjective_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
    Function.Surjective (abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C).base :=
  surjective_of_isLocallySurjective_yoneda_map _
    (isLocallySurjective_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C)

/-- The exact separably closed Picard representing scheme is quasi-compact over its field. -/
theorem quasiCompact_pic0SepClosedRepresenter (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
    QuasiCompact (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.hom := by
  haveI : CompactSpace (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C).left :=
    HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine.mp (quasiCompact_divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C)
  exact quasiCompact_of_surjective (abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C)
    (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.hom
    (surjective_abelToPic0SepClosedRepresenter C)

/-- The separably closed representability theorem, recorded in the finite-level Picard datum
shape at the same field. -/
noncomputable def picRepDatumSepClosed (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] : PicRepDatum k k C where
  J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
  rep := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2
  lft := locallyOfFiniteType_pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)

noncomputable def jacobianDataSepClosed (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] : JacobianData C :=
  (picRepDatumSepClosed C).toJacobianData (quasiCompact_pic0SepClosedRepresenter C)

    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
    (picRepDatumSepClosed C).J = (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 :=
  rfl

theorem picRepDatumSepClosed_rep (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
    (picRepDatumSepClosed C).rep = (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2 :=
  rfl

theorem jacobianDataSepClosed_J (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
    (jacobianDataSepClosed C).J = (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1 :=
  rfl

theorem jacobianDataSepClosed_rep (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k] :
    (jacobianDataSepClosed C).rep = (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).2 :=
  rfl

end
